event_summary: A small light gray spherical object enters from the lower left, moves rightward across the foreground tabletop, and exits at the lower right while the room remains otherwise unchanged.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a stationary view of a yellow sofa behind a pale tabletop, with a black cylindrical object at the lower left and a lamp on a side table at the right. For several frames no moving object is visible. A small light gray sphere then appears from the lower-left edge of the frame near the black cylinder. It travels rightward across the pale tabletop in the foreground, passing through the lower central area and then the lower-right area. The sphere leaves the frame at the right edge. After it exits, the scene returns to a static view of the sofa, tabletop, black cylinder, and lamp.

reasons: The room layout and stationary furniture are clearly visible.
The moving spherical object is not visible in the first frame.
